firstPlayerRule: Everyone guesses the current time. The closest guess goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: This selects the starter for the multiplayer game. Solonauts is a separate solitaire mode with no competing first player.
